headline: A 2016 law renamed a Sugar Land, Texas post office after a Marine lance corporal, Garrett W. Gamble.
what_it_does: The law names the U.S. Postal Service building at 3130 Grants Lake Boulevard in Sugar Land, Texas, the "LCpl Garrett W. Gamble, USMC Post Office Building." It is a naming measure only. It does not change how the post office operates, its services, or its staff.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on July 29, 2016.
